cs.t: Elitekeyboards also offers models from Leopold. ( http://elitekeyboards.com/products.php?sub=leopold,tenkeyles... ) These are a lot less expensive than happy hacking and  also have a reduced size form-factor (no numpad). I got the model with cherry-mx blue switches (very clicky and tactile like the old 80's IBM keyboards). I got the "otaku" model without the key markings and it looks very cool.
